text:
Sam (People Ops): heads-up: we've updated the Benefits Eligibility & Documentation section in the handbook. This clarifies dependent verification docs and introduces a short manager certification step for benefit changes that affect payroll. Link: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/benefits-eligibility :bookmark_tabs:

Ivy (Benefits): summary: 1) clearer list of acceptable docs per region, 2) new 5-min manager certification when approving dependent additions, 3) localized examples for EU/UK/IN. Certification is required for HR audit traces.

Jon (HRBP): quick Q: is the manager certification a separate microtraining or just a checkbox plus attestation?

Sam (People Ops): it's a tiny workflow: checkbox + two question attestation + timestamped signature (SAML identity). The flow records certifier email + manager's team id.

Rina (Mgr, Sales): is there an exception for people on parental leave? they can't always respond quickly to doc requests.

Ivy (Benefits): yes — managers can mark 'proof pending' and set a 30-day follow-up. If docs aren't provided after 30 days, HR will pause benefit change and notify payroll. We'll add the exemption code in the FAQ.

Diego (People Ops): rollout plan: send to all managers in NA, EMEA, LATAM on Mon. Managers must complete the cert flow for any benefit change submitted after rollout for 60 days. After 60 days policy becomes baseline. Reminder cadence: 48h, 5d, final 72h before expiration.

Sam (People Ops): training: 8-min manager microlearning + 3-question quiz required. Passing quiz = 80% or above. We will track completion in the Manager Compliance dashboard.

Diego (People Ops): adding localized manager email templates (EN/ES/FR/DE) to the intranet doc. If you want a copy to send from your own mailbox, use the "manager-copy" link on the page.

Rina (Mgr, Sales): can we get the copy in Spanish? my reps in LATAM prefer manager-sent messages.

Diego (People Ops): yes — Spanish template is uploaded. Also: if a manager prefers to bulk-verify completions, we support CSV upload. Template below. Upload path: Manager > Compliance > Bulk Verify.

Diego (People Ops): ```csv
manager_email, employee_email, employee_id, action, note
rina@redwood.com, paola@redwood.com, 99221, cert_completed, verified docs on 2026-03-10
```

Jon (HRBP): for matrix teams: which manager certifies dependent docs? home manager or payroll owner?

Ivy (Benefits): either manager can certify; the system accepts the first valid certification. If there's conflict, benefits team will reconcile and reach out. We'll note this in the matrix section.

Sam (People Ops): audit retention: all cert records and CSV upload receipts are retained for 5 years in line with the revised records retention schedule. Also adding export job schedule: weekly snapshot every Monday 00:00 UTC for the first 12 months.

Rina (Mgr, Sales): great. can we get a weekly digest of pending certs for my direct reports? saves me from hunting in the dashboard.

Diego (People Ops): can do — I'll enable weekly manager digests (Mon am local time) for any manager who opts in. Opt-in link in the intranet note.

hr-bot: :white_check_mark: Manager certification workflow deployed to staging. Live rollout scheduled Mon 2026-04-06.

Rina (Mgr, Sales): thanks team. I'll sign up for the Spanish manager template and opt into the digest.

Sam (People Ops): thanks all. tagging Docs to add a short FAQ with examples per region. I'll follow up with a calendar invite for two manager drop-in hours next Wed. If anyone needs a localized attestation sample, DM me.
